caseStudies.title: Enterprise Delivery Intelligence Platform
caseStudies.summary: Delivery information for engineering teams lives across Jira, GitHub and Confluence. I'm leading the architecture and delivery of an Agentic AI platform in Microsoft Teams that answers engineering leaders' delivery questions from those sources, with citations they can check.
caseStudies.pipelineNote: Simplified view of how a question is answered. Jira, GitHub and Confluence data arrives through event-driven ingestion (webhooks, SQS, S3, Redis).
details: Leading architecture and delivery of an enterprise Agentic AI platform serving 500+ engineering leaders across 50+ teams.
Designed LangGraph-based multi-agent workflows with source verification and citation mechanisms.
Architected hybrid RAG using PostgreSQL + pgvector across Jira, GitHub and Confluence data sources.
Built event-driven ingestion pipelines using AWS SQS, S3, Redis and webhooks.
Established RBAC, audit logging, observability and security controls for enterprise adoption.
Reduced manual delivery investigation effort by approximately 50%.

caseStudies.title: AI Shopping Assistant & Visual Product Discovery
caseStudies.summary: Technicians often know what's broken but not the part number. I architected a multimodal assistant where they describe what they need or upload a photo of a broken tool or missing vehicle part, and get compatible replacements with technical guidance.

metrics.label: search by description or by image

caseStudies.pipelineNote: Simplified view of the visual search and recommendation flow.
details: Architected a multimodal AI assistant that lets technicians identify tools and vehicle parts through natural language and image uploads.
Developed a visual search workflow that matches photos of broken tools or missing vehicle components against the product catalog using image embeddings and vector search.
Built a RAG-powered recommendation engine with LangChain, Pinecone and AWS Bedrock for technical guidance and compatible replacement recommendations.
Increased recommendation conversion by 15% through AI-powered search and personalized product discovery.

caseStudies.title: E-commerce and financing platform for the tool trade
caseStudies.summary: A commerce platform serving technicians and distributors across the USA and Canada, with built-in financing so technicians can buy expensive equipment on EMI.
details: Designed and scaled the platform for 150,000+ technicians and 2,000+ distributors across the USA and Canada.
Architected microservices and GraphQL APIs for customer onboarding, product catalog management, financing approvals and payment processing.
Built financing and EMI management workflows that increased financed purchases by 25%.
Optimized critical purchasing APIs, cutting checkout latency from 2.5s to 800ms.

caseStudies.title: Loan management for enterprise banking
caseStudies.summary: Enterprise loan management modules for investors, suppliers and buyers inside HSBC's banking systems, built on React, Node.js and microservices.
details: Developed enterprise loan management modules for investors, suppliers and buyers using React, Node.js and microservices architecture.
Built and integrated REST APIs supporting loan approval workflows, reducing processing time by 30%.
Optimized application performance through frontend and API enhancements, improving response times by 25%.
Contributed to AWS-based deployment, monitoring and production support.
